sections.title: Steady, age-appropriate learning
sections.lead: Families want children to grow in group learning without losing the joy of early childhood.
points: A bridge between playful preschool experiences and more structured school habits.
Support for listening, expression, independence, and participation.
Guidance that helps children feel ready without pushing too quickly.
sections.closing: School readiness includes attention, communication, curiosity, confidence, and happy participation with others.

sections.title: Growth through meaningful experiences
sections.lead: A good kindergarten program strengthens language, early thinking, listening, and classroom habits through daily experiences.
points: Movement, conversation, stories, songs, creative tasks, and guided play.
Child-friendly learning methods that avoid making the classroom too formal too soon.
Teachers who notice small improvements and help children trust their abilities.
sections.closing: When learning feels natural, families can see the difference in everyday confidence.
